businesses.business: customer experience outsourcing and technology services

offering_description.value: Concentrix runs customer support, technical support, sales and back-office operations for businesses and public agencies. It also designs and implements digital customer experiences and IT systems. It delivers these services through global teams and uses its own software alongside third-party technology.
